text: Why is China’s personal income tax revenue growing faster than earnings? South China Morning Post
zh: 为什么中国个人所得税收入增速快于收入增速？南华早报

title: Microsoft commits $2.5 billion and 6,000 employees to new AI implementation unit
title_zh: 微软承诺为新的人工智能实施部门投入 25 亿美元和 6,000 名员工
text: Microsoft is the latest tech company to form a business focused on helping customers understand and implement artificial intelligence.
zh: 微软是最新一家专注于帮助客户理解和实施人工智能业务的科技公司。

title: Tesla stock sinks 7% despite strong deliveries report
title_zh: 尽管交付报告强劲，特斯拉股价仍下跌 7%
text: Tesla is trying to recover from consecutive annual declines in vehicle sales that were partly caused by a consumer backlash against CEO Elon Musk.
zh: 特斯拉正试图从汽车销量连续年度下滑的局面中恢复过来，部分原因是消费者对首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的强烈反对。

title: Treasury says Trump Account investment options will include State Street, BlackRock and Vanguard ETFs
title_zh: 财政部表示特朗普账户投资选择将包括道富银行、贝莱德和先锋 ETF
text: The Treasury Department said the investment lineup for Trump ‌Accounts includes ETFs from State Street, BlackRock and Vanguard.
zh: 美国财政部表示，特朗普账户的投资阵容包括道富银行、贝莱德和先锋集团的 ETF。

title: Autonomous drone startup Quantum Systems raises $1.2 billion as investors pile into defense
title_zh: 投资者纷纷进军国防领域，自主无人机初创公司 Quantum Systems 融资 12 亿美元
text: Defense tech startups are raising record amounts on both sides of the Atlantic amid a flurry of investment in the sector.
zh: 大西洋两岸的国防科技初创公司在该领域的投资热潮中筹集了创纪录的资金。

title: Led by Buc-ee’s and new rival Dolly Parton, America’s gas station chains are in a mega-sizing era
title_zh: 在 Buc-ee’s 和新竞争对手 Dolly Parton 的带领下，美国连锁加油站正处于大型时代
text: Gas station chains led by Buc-ee's are coming closer to rivaling America's big box stores in size, and Dolly Parton is getting in on the retail trend.
zh: 以 Buc-ee's 为首的连锁加油站在规模上已接近与美国大型卖场相媲美，而 Dolly Parton 也正在紧随零售潮流。

title: Ford Q2 sales drop 10.3% due to F-Series supplier issue, falling EV demand
title_zh: 由于F系列供应商问题和电动汽车需求下降，福特第二季度销量下降10.3%
text: Ford said its EV sales fell by 40.7% during the quarter compared with a year earlier, while sales of its F-Series trucks, including the F-150, declined 11%.
zh: 福特表示，该季度电动汽车销量同比下降 40.7%，而包括 F-150 在内的 F 系列卡车销量下降 11%。

title: Trump says 'everybody's profiting' from recent market rallies — but it’s mostly the 1%
title_zh: 特朗普表示“每个人都从最近的市场反弹中获利”——但主要是 1%
text: A large share of U.S. households have no exposure to equities and have not benefited from the bull market.
zh: 很大一部分美国家庭没有投资股票，也没有从牛市中受益。

title: Stock market gains minted nearly 1 million new millionaires in 2025, new UBS report says
title_zh: 瑞银新报告称，股市上涨将在 2025 年创造近 100 万新百万富翁
text: Global personal wealth surged by 10.8% in 2025, the biggest jump since 2017, per UBS.
zh: 根据瑞银的数据，2025 年全球个人财富将飙升 10.8%，这是自 2017 年以来的最大增幅。

title: How high hopes for Biden’s student-loan forgiveness plans cost borrowers
title_zh: 对拜登学生贷款减免计划的厚望让借款人付出了多大代价
text: The Biden White House's lofty expectations for its loan forgiveness efforts inadvertently damaged the financial situation of many student loan borrowers.
zh: 拜登白宫对其贷款减免努力的殷切期望无意中损害了许多学生贷款借款人的财务状况。

title: Palantir’s stock bounces back as analyst cheers company’s unique AI advantage
title_zh: Palantir 股价反弹，分析师称赞该公司独特的人工智能优势
text: The software company’s shares have gotten off to a strong start this month following a weak run in June.
zh: 这家软件公司的股价继 6 月份的疲软运行后，本月开局强劲。

title: How you as an investor can get ahead of the next AI investment wave
title_zh: 作为投资者，您如何才能领先于下一波人工智能投资浪潮
text: Also in Weekend Reads: Eldercare and family relationships, stock-market prospects for the second half of 2026, and how to set your summer streaming budget.
zh: 周末读物还包括：老年护理和家庭关系、2026 年下半年股市前景以及如何设定夏季流媒体预算。

title: Why a founder at age 50 is twice as likely to find success as one at age 30
title_zh: 为什么 50 岁的创始人取得成功的可能性是 30 岁的创始人的两倍
text: Older workers are fighting ageism by starting their own businesses — and they’re outperforming younger entrepreneurs
zh: 年长工人通过创办自己的企业来对抗年龄歧视，而且他们的表现优于年轻企业家

title: I have no kids. Will I cause family drama by leaving different amounts to my nieces and nephews?
title_zh: 我没有孩子。我给侄女和侄子留下不同数额的钱会引起家庭闹剧吗？
text: “Part of me would prefer to leave more to those for whom the money could make a meaningful difference.”
zh: “我内心的一部分更愿意把更多的钱留给那些能够产生有意义的改变的人。”

title: Tesla crushes delivery estimates as it’s seen ‘exiting the EV winter’
title_zh: 特斯拉交付量预期超预期，因为该公司已“走出电动汽车冬天”
text: The automaker shipped 480,126 EVs to consumers last quarter — much more than even bullish analysts projected.
zh: 该汽车制造商上季度向消费者交付了 480,126 辆电动汽车，远高于乐观分析师的预期。

title: Our economic outlook for China - Vanguard Corporate
title_zh: 我们对中国经济的展望 - Vanguard Corporate
text: Our economic outlook for China Vanguard Corporate
zh: 我们对中国先锋集团的经济展望

title: U.S. economy added 57,000 jobs in June, less than expected; unemployment rate at 4.2%
title_zh: 美国6月新增就业岗位5.7万个，低于预期；失业率为 4.2%
text: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to rise by 115,000 in June while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3%.
zh: 6 月份非农就业人数预计增加 11.5 万人，失业率稳定在 4.3%。

title: Rivian raises 2026 delivery outlook while Lucid misses Wall Street expectations for second quarter
title_zh: Rivian 上调 2026 年交付预期，而 Lucid 未达到华尔街对第二季度的预期
text: Rivian is increasing its delivery outlook to between 65,000 and 70,000 EVs, up from 62,000 to 67,000 units.
zh: Rivian 将电动汽车的交付量预期从 62,000 辆上调至 67,000 辆，上调至 65,000 辆至 70,000 辆。

title: Meta’s push into cloud computing means Wall Street has to prepare for lower margins
title_zh: Meta进军云计算意味着华尔街必须为利润率下降做好准备
text: Meta appears poised to enter the cloud computing market in an effort to monetize its massive AI infrastructure.
zh: Meta 似乎准备进入云计算市场，以期通过其庞大的人工智能基础设施获利。

title: Jeff Bezos' family office backed five AI startups in June
title_zh: 杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 的家族办公室在 6 月份投资了五家人工智能初创公司
text: Bezos Expeditions is now the most active family office investor thus far this year, per data from Fintrx.
zh: 根据 Fintrx 的数据，贝索斯探险队目前是今年迄今为止最活跃的家族办公室投资者。

title: Most prediction market contracts have low volume, leaving users exposed to volatility and bots
title_zh: 大多数预测市场合约的交易量都很低，使用户面临波动和机器人的影响
text: Prediction market volume has grown exponentially but several markets never make it over $10,000.
zh: 预测市场规模呈指数增长，但有几个市场从未超过 10,000 美元。

title: High-end camping and a capital raise: AutoCamp is banking on summer travel to fuel growth
title_zh: 高端露营和融资：AutoCamp 指望夏季旅行来推动增长
text: AutoCamp offers Airstream suites, polished cabins, fire pits, design-forward amenities and access to iconic outdoor destinations.
zh: AutoCamp 提供气流套房、精美的小屋、火坑、设计先进的设施，并可通往标志性的户外目的地。

title: Ford CEO wants level playing field with Toyota, GM imports as USMCA trade talks reopen
title_zh: 随着USMCA贸易谈判重新开启，福特首席执行官希望与丰田、通用汽车进口产品建立公平的竞争环境
text: Ford reports it assembled more than 2 million vehicles in the U.S. last year – more than any other auto manufacturer, including 311,000 units for export.
zh: 福特报告称，去年该公司在美国组装了超过 200 万辆汽车，比任何其他汽车制造商都多，其中包括 311,000 辆用于出口。

title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Thursday
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周四股市最值得关注的 10 件事
text: The June jobs report came in weak, and Palantir landed a big upgrade.
zh: 6 月份就业报告疲弱，Palantir 大幅升级。

title: Brookfield wants to build AI data centers in London’s answer to Wall Street
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德希望在伦敦建立人工智能数据中心，以回应华尔街
text: Brookfield's CEO said the firm is bringing data centers to London's Canary Wharf, as demand for AI infrastructure in the U.K. soars.
zh: Brookfield 首席执行官表示，随着英国对人工智能基础设施的需求飙升，该公司正在将数据中心迁至伦敦金丝雀码头。

title: ‘I don’t think I’ll make it to 80’: I’m 70 and single. Do I take out a reverse mortgage or a home-equity agreement?
title_zh: “我不认为我能活到 80 岁”：我已经 70 岁了，还是单身。我是否需要申请反向抵押贷款或房屋净值协议？
text: “I’m torn between these two options.”
zh: “我在这两个选择之间左右为难。”

title: ‘She wants him gone’: My friend took in a homeless man as a caretaker. After 10 years, how can she evict him?
title_zh: “她希望他离开”：我的朋友收留了一名无家可归的人作为看护人。十年了，她怎么能赶走他？
text: “He lived rent-free, helping her with health-related issues and other tasks.”
zh: “他免租居住，帮助她解决与健康相关的问题和其他任务。”

title: I’m a 35-year-old American living in Japan. How can I build long-term wealth without a 401(k) or Roth IRA?
title_zh: 我是一位住在日本的 35 岁美国人。如果没有 401(k) 或 Roth IRA，我如何才能积累长期财富？
text: “Some financial institutions limit services for customers with foreign addresses.”
zh: “一些金融机构限制为拥有外国地址的客户提供服务。”

title: Want to live longer in retirement? This one money move could add years to your life.
title_zh: 想在退休后活得更久吗？这一笔钱的举动可能会延长你的寿命。
text: A secure retirement portfolio acts like a health shield, calming market anxiety that can actually shorten life expectancy.
zh: 安全的退休投资组合就像健康盾牌，可以平息市场焦虑，而这种焦虑实际上会缩短预期寿命。

title: Is the stock market open tomorrow, or will it close early for the Fourth of July?
title_zh: 股市明天开市还是七月四日提前收市？
text: Since Independence Day falls on Saturday this year, here’s what to know about trading hours and mail delivery
zh: 由于今年的独立日是星期六，因此以下是有关交易时间和邮件投递的信息

title: ‘We are more likely to be living in poverty’: Social Security is a lifeline for women, so why are we ignored?
title_zh: “我们更有可能生活在贫困之中”：社会保障是女性的生命线，为何我们却被忽视？
text: “We are more likely to live longer, to live alone and to be caregivers.”
zh: “我们更有可能活得更久，独自生活并成为照顾者。”

title: Americans are paying record prices for steak. Here's why demand isn't cracking
title_zh: 美国人正在为牛排支付创纪录的价格。这就是需求没有增长的原因
text: Despite record beef prices, Americans aren't giving up steak. Consumers are treating beef as an affordable luxury and prioritizing it for special occasions.
zh: 尽管牛肉价格创历史新高，美国人并没有放弃牛排。消费者将牛肉视为一种负担得起的奢侈品，并在特殊场合优先考虑它。

title: SpaceX may emerge as ultimate blueprint for new wave of mega-cap IPOs
title_zh: SpaceX可能成为新一波大型IPO的最终蓝图
text: "It would not surprise me at all to see a similar dynamic play out with some of these [IPOs] set to come in the months ahead," the Kathmere Capital CIO says.
zh: Kathmere Capital 首席信息官表示：“如果在未来几个月内看到其中一些 [IPO] 出现类似的动态，我一点也不感到惊讶。”

title: Nvidia offers start-up customers chance to swap compute power for revenue share
title_zh: Nvidia 为初创客户提供以计算能力换取收入分成的机会
text: Nvidia says it will give start-ups the chance to swap access to compute power for a slice of future profits under a new program aimed at AI-focused firms.
zh: 英伟达表示，根据一项针对人工智能公司的新计划，它将为初创企业提供用计算能力来换取未来利润的机会。

title: AI agents will soon be able to match human traders, Robinhood CEO tells CNBC
title_zh: Robinhood 首席执行官告诉 CNBC，人工智能代理很快就能与人类交易员相匹配
text: Vlad Tenev spoke about the potential of AI agents in trading in an interview with CNBC.
zh: Vlad Tenev 在接受 CNBC 采访时谈到了人工智能代理在交易中的潜力。

title: U.S. won’t renew USMCA, opening door for negotiations with Canada and Mexico
title_zh: 美国不会续签USMCA，为与加拿大和墨西哥的谈判打开大门
text: President Donald Trump's "primary" issue with USMCA centers on America's trade deficits with Canada and Mexico, a senior administration official said.
zh: 一位高级政府官员表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统对《美墨加协定》的“主要”问题集中在美国与加拿大和墨西哥的贸易逆差上。

title: Russia’s neighbor Lithuania scraps constitutional ban on nuclear weapons. Here's why
title_zh: 俄罗斯的邻国立陶宛废除了核武器宪法禁令。这就是为什么
text: The decision comes shortly after lawmakers in Finland voted to lift its longstanding ban on nuclear weapons.
zh: 这一决定是在芬兰立法者投票解除其长期的核武器禁令后不久做出的。

title: Warsh faces multiple alternative inflation signs as Fed charts new course
title_zh: 随着美联储制定新方针，沃什面临多种替代通胀迹象
text: Warsh has said that inflation is a "choice." The same could also be true of how inflation is measured.
zh: 沃什曾表示，通货膨胀是一种“选择”。通货膨胀的衡量方式也可能如此。

title: This fund manager bought Nvidia and SK Hynix and sold software before others. His simple message on AI: ‘Follow the money.’
title_zh: 这位基金经理先于其他人购买了 Nvidia 和 SK Hynix，并出售了软件。他对人工智能的简单信息是：“追随金钱。”
text: Blue Whale Growth Fund manager exited software stocks before many others did.
zh: 蓝鲸成长基金经理先于许多人退出了软件股。

title: ‘There was a catch’: My doctor friend was outraged by his hospital’s fundraising tactics. Where do we draw the line?
title_zh: “有一个问题”：我的医生朋友对他医院的筹款策略感到愤怒。我们在哪里划清界限？
text: “This shocking program was exploiting doctors and the trust inherent in their relationships with patients.”
zh: “这个令人震惊的计划正在利用医生以及他们与患者关系中固有的信任。”

title: Warsh’s throwaway comment injects life into the debasement trade, for one day at least
title_zh: 沃什的一次性评论至少在一天内为贬低交易注入了活力
text: As much as new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tried to refrain from steering markets, it looks like he did.
zh: 尽管新任美联储主席凯文·沃什试图克制自己对市场的引导，但看起来他确实做到了。
